ex.en: He shared his box of biscuits with all his friends.
ex.zh: 他和他所有的朋友分享了他的那盒餅乾。

ex.en: Christmas is a time for giving and sharing.
ex.zh: 聖誕節是給予和分享的時節。

ex.en: To share one's passion is to live it fully.
ex.zh: 分享你的熱情，就是充分地活出它。

ex.en: He shares a room with his brother.
ex.zh: 他和他兄弟共用一個房間。

ex.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
ex.zh: 越來越多夫妻一起分擔家事。

ex.en: She owns shares in several tech companies.
ex.zh: 她持有好幾家科技公司的股份。

ex.en: The company's shares rose by 5% today.
ex.zh: 這家公司的股價今天上漲 5%。

ex.en: Shortly after the accident, the police came.
ex.zh: 事故發生後不久，警察就來了。

ex.en: Tom will join us shortly.
ex.zh: 湯姆很快就會來跟我們會合。

ex.en: The meeting will begin shortly.
ex.zh: 會議即將開始。

ex.en: Black Friday sales attract shoppers.
ex.zh: 黑色星期五的特賣吸引了許多購物人潮。

ex.en: Shoppers crowded the streets.
ex.zh: 街上擠滿了購物的人。

ex.en: Online shoppers can return items within 30 days.
ex.zh: 網購顧客可以在三十天內退貨。

ex.en: We visited the car showroom on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們星期六去了汽車展示中心。

ex.en: The furniture is on display in our showroom.
ex.zh: 這些家具在我們的展示間展示。

ex.en: I shortened my speeches.
ex.zh: 我把演講縮短了。

ex.en: Can you shorten this report to two pages?
ex.zh: 你可以把這份報告縮短成兩頁嗎？

ex.en: The meeting was shortened to 30 minutes.
ex.zh: 會議縮短為三十分鐘。

ex.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
ex.zh: 企業第一季獲利大幅改善。

ex.en: Industrial production rose sharply in July.
ex.zh: 七月工業生產大幅成長。

ex.en: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
ex.zh: 新竹市的房價因科技產業聚集而大幅上漲。

ex.en: She spoke sharply to the staff.
ex.zh: 她對員工說話很嚴厲。

ex.en: The plan was sharply criticized by experts.
ex.zh: 這個計畫遭到專家嚴厲批評。

ex.en: Fruit that has been left for a long time will shrink.
ex.zh: 水果放太久就會乾癟。

ex.en: My sweater shrank in the wash.
ex.zh: 我的毛衣洗了以後縮水了。

ex.en: The company's market share has shrunk this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年的市占率縮小了。

ex.en: You need to shed some pounds.
ex.zh: 你需要減掉幾磅。

ex.en: The company plans to shed 500 jobs this year.
ex.zh: 公司計畫今年裁減 500 個職位。

ex.en: She shed tears.
ex.zh: 她流下了眼淚。

ex.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
ex.zh: 那棟舊大樓要是被拆了，也沒有人會覺得可惜。

shed.zh: shed light on：使…更清楚、闡明

ex.en: The report sheds light on the causes of the problem.
ex.zh: 這份報告釐清了問題的成因。

ex.en: Can you shed some light on this issue?
ex.zh: 你能幫忙說明一下這個問題嗎？

ex.en: Tom hid in the shed.
ex.zh: 湯姆躲在小屋裡。

ex.en: We keep our bikes in the shed.
ex.zh: 我們把腳踏車放在小屋裡。

ex.en: The police officers held up their shields.
ex.zh: 警察舉起盾牌。

ex.en: The screen acts as a shield against the sun.
ex.zh: 這塊屏幕可以遮擋陽光。

ex.en: She shielded her eyes from the sun.
ex.zh: 她用手遮住眼睛擋太陽。

ex.en: Parents can't shield their children from every problem.
ex.zh: 父母無法替孩子擋下所有問題。

ex.en: The company faces a budget shortfall of two million dollars.
ex.zh: 公司面臨兩百萬美元的預算缺口。

ex.en: We need to cover the shortfall in staff.
ex.zh: 我們需要補足人力的不足。

sheer.zh: 純粹的、完全的；（數量）龐大的

ex.en: It is a sheer waste of time.
ex.zh: 這完全是浪費時間。

ex.en: He succeeded through sheer hard work.
ex.zh: 他完全是靠努力成功的。

ex.en: The sheer size of the stadium amazed us.
ex.zh: 體育場的規模之大讓我們驚嘆。

ex.en: She put two pairs of sheer tights in the suitcase.
ex.zh: 她在行李箱裡放了兩雙透膚褲襪。

ex.en: She wore a sheer white blouse.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件薄透的白襯衫。

ex.en: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
ex.zh: 他給我看了他新劇本的手稿。

ex.en: Would you show us some samples of your work?
ex.zh: 可以給我們看一些你的作品樣本嗎？

ex.en: That shows how little we know of ourselves.
ex.zh: 這說明我們對自己了解得很少。

ex.en: My data-burning software is showing an error message.
ex.zh: 我的燒錄軟體顯示了一則錯誤訊息。

ex.en: Let me show you around the office.
ex.zh: 我帶你參觀一下辦公室。

ex.en: Can you show me the way to the station?
ex.zh: 你可以告訴我去車站怎麼走嗎？

ex.en: Let's have lunch downtown and take in a show.
ex.zh: 我們去市區吃午餐，順便看場表演吧。

ex.en: What's your favorite TV show?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡的電視節目是什麼？

ex.en: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
ex.zh: 兔子有長耳朵和短尾巴。

ex.en: Is there a shorter road to get there?
ex.zh: 有比較近的路可以到那裡嗎？

ex.en: I wonder which way is the shortest.
ex.zh: 我想知道哪條路最近。

ex.en: He is short but very strong.
ex.zh: 他個子矮但很強壯。

ex.en: My brother is shorter than me.
ex.zh: 我弟弟比我矮。

ex.en: Let's take a short break.
ex.zh: 我們稍微休息一下吧。

ex.en: Please keep your answer short.
ex.zh: 請簡短回答。

ex.en: We are not short of oil in this country.
ex.zh: 我們國家不缺石油。

ex.en: We are short of staff this week.
ex.zh: 我們這週人手不足。

ex.en: The shop is just in front of the station.
ex.zh: 那家店就在車站正前方。

ex.en: There are a few shops next to my house.
ex.zh: 我家旁邊有幾家商店。

ex.en: My uncle has a flower shop near the station.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在車站附近開了一家花店。

ex.en: I usually shop online.
ex.zh: 我通常在網路上買東西。

ex.en: We went shopping at the mall.
ex.zh: 我們去購物中心逛街。

ex.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
ex.zh: 那棟房子因為形狀特殊而很顯眼。

ex.en: That cloud is in the shape of a fish.
ex.zh: 那片雲是魚的形狀。

ex.en: The earth is similar to an orange in shape.
ex.zh: 地球的形狀和柳橙很像。

ex.en: I need to get back in shape.
ex.zh: 我需要把身材練回來。

ex.en: The old car is still in good shape.
ex.zh: 那台舊車的狀況還很好。

ex.en: This fruit is shaped like an orange and tastes like a pineapple.
ex.zh: 這種水果形狀像柳橙，吃起來像鳳梨。

ex.en: Our experiences shape who we are.
ex.zh: 我們的經歷塑造了我們。

ex.en: She shoots at paper targets at the archery club every Sunday.
ex.zh: 她每個星期天都在射箭俱樂部射紙靶。

ex.en: The guard was trained to shoot only as a last resort.
ex.zh: 警衛受過訓練，只有在萬不得已時才開槍。

ex.en: The movie was shot in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這部電影是在台灣拍攝的。

ex.en: We're shooting a video for our new product.
ex.zh: 我們正在為新產品拍一支影片。

ex.en: He shot the ball from the middle of the court.
ex.zh: 他從中場投籃。

ex.en: She shot and scored in the last minute.
ex.zh: 她在最後一分鐘射門得分。

ex.en: The photo shoot took all afternoon.
ex.zh: 拍照花了一整個下午。

ex.en: We have a shoot at the studio tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天在攝影棚有拍攝工作。

ex.en: It was a great shock to me.
ex.zh: 這對我是很大的打擊。

ex.en: His death was great shock to his wife.
ex.zh: 他的死讓他太太大受打擊。

ex.en: She got over the shock of her father's death.
ex.zh: 她從父親過世的打擊中走了出來。

ex.en: My dad was completely shocked by my silly question.
ex.zh: 我爸完全被我的蠢問題嚇到了。

ex.en: What shocked us greatly was his sudden resignation.
ex.zh: 讓我們非常震驚的是他突然辭職。

ex.en: Don't touch the wire, or you'll get a shock.
ex.zh: 別碰那條電線，不然會觸電。

ex.en: I got an electric shock from the old toaster.
ex.zh: 我被那台舊烤麵包機電到了。

ex.en: We felt the house shake a little.
ex.zh: 我們感覺房子搖晃了一下。

ex.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
ex.zh: 我的手抖得太厲害，沒辦法穿針。

ex.en: Speak the truth, even if your voice shakes.
ex.zh: 即使聲音發抖，也要說出實話。

ex.en: I entered the room and shook hands with him.
ex.zh: 我走進房間和他握手。

ex.en: I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.
ex.zh: 我永遠不會忘記去年和總統握手的那一刻。

ex.en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
ex.zh: 穿上鞋子，我們出去吃晚餐。

ex.en: Do I have to take off my shoes here?
ex.zh: 在這裡要脫鞋嗎？

ex.en: Wait a second. My shoe is untied.
ex.zh: 等一下，我的鞋帶鬆了。

ex.en: That's a great shot of the sunset.
ex.zh: 那張夕陽照拍得很棒。

ex.en: The opening shot of the movie is beautiful.
ex.zh: 這部電影的開場鏡頭很美。

shot.zh: 嘗試（give it a shot 試試看）

ex.en: I've never tried surfing, but I'll give it a shot.
ex.zh: 我從沒衝過浪，但我會試試看。

ex.en: It's a long shot, but it's worth a try.
ex.zh: 希望不大，但值得一試。

ex.en: Did you get your flu shot this year?
ex.zh: 你今年打流感疫苗了嗎？

ex.en: The nurse gave me a shot in the arm.
ex.zh: 護理師在我手臂上打了一針。

ex.en: All at once we heard a shot outside.
ex.zh: 我們突然聽見外面一聲槍響。

ex.en: He fired three shots.
ex.zh: 他開了三槍。

ex.en: I felt somebody pat me on the shoulder.
ex.zh: 我感覺有人拍了拍我的肩膀。

ex.en: He put a hand gently on her shoulder.
ex.zh: 他把手輕輕放在她的肩上。

ex.en: A great responsibility lies on his shoulders.
ex.zh: 他肩負著重大的責任。

ex.en: She had to shoulder the responsibility alone.
ex.zh: 她必須獨自承擔這個責任。

ex.en: Taxpayers will shoulder the cost of the project.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的費用將由納稅人負擔。

ex.en: She put clean sheets on the bed.
ex.zh: 她在床上鋪了乾淨的床單。

ex.en: You put away the sheets, and I'll make the bed.
ex.zh: 你把床單收好，我來鋪床。

ex.en: She pressed her nose against the sheet of glass.
ex.zh: 她把鼻子貼在玻璃上。

ex.en: Please write your name on a sheet of paper.
ex.zh: 請在一張紙上寫下你的名字。

ex.en: Fill in your time sheet every Friday.
ex.zh: 每週五要填寫工時表。

ex.en: Check the fact sheet for product details.
ex.zh: 產品細節請參考資料表。

ex.en: I heard someone shout outside the window.
ex.zh: 我聽到窗外有人大叫。

ex.en: Shouting at your computer will not help.
ex.zh: 對電腦大吼一點用都沒有。

ex.en: He shouted at the top of his lungs.
ex.zh: 他放聲大喊。

ex.en: We heard a shout from upstairs.
ex.zh: 我們聽到樓上傳來一聲喊叫。

ex.en: She gave a shout of joy.
ex.zh: 她高興地大叫了一聲。

ex.en: "Would you mind shutting the door?" "No, not at all."
ex.zh: 「你介意把門關上嗎？」「不介意，沒問題。」

ex.en: Just pull the door shut. It'll lock by itself.
ex.zh: 把門拉上就好，它會自動上鎖。

ex.en: Please shut the window. It's cold.
ex.zh: 請把窗戶關上，好冷。

shut.zh: shut down：關閉；停止運作、關機

ex.en: Heads up! The server will shut down at midnight.
ex.zh: 注意！伺服器會在午夜關機。

ex.en: Skype is shutting down in May of 2025.
ex.zh: Skype 將在 2025 年 5 月停止服務。

ex.en: Be careful, that knife is very sharp.
ex.zh: 小心，那把刀很利。

ex.en: Use a sharp pencil for the drawing.
ex.zh: 畫這張圖要用削尖的鉛筆。

ex.en: There was a sharp rise in sales last month.
ex.zh: 上個月業績急劇上升。

ex.en: The road makes a sharp turn ahead.
ex.zh: 前方道路有個急轉彎。

ex.en: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
ex.zh: 他的觀察很敏銳，但話不多。

ex.en: She has a sharp mind for business.
ex.zh: 她很有商業頭腦。

ex.en: Be at the station at 11 o'clock sharp.
ex.zh: 十一點整到車站。

ex.en: The meeting starts at nine o'clock sharp.
ex.zh: 會議九點整開始。

ex.en: This shirt doesn't go with that tie at all.
ex.zh: 這件襯衫跟那條領帶完全不搭。

ex.en: In the summer I wear short-sleeved shirts.
ex.zh: 夏天我穿短袖襯衫。

ex.en: The second button of your shirt is coming off.
ex.zh: 你襯衫的第二顆扣子快掉了。

ex.en: He is afraid of his own shadow.
ex.zh: 他連自己的影子都怕。

ex.en: Zebra shadows don't have stripes.
ex.zh: 斑馬的影子沒有條紋。

ex.en: What is lurking in the shadows?
ex.zh: 陰暗處潛伏著什麼？

ex.en: By late afternoon, the garden was in shadow.
ex.zh: 到了傍晚，花園已籠罩在陰影中。

shadow.zh: 跟隨見習（觀摩他人工作）

ex.en: New employees shadow a senior colleague for a week.
ex.zh: 新員工會跟著資深同事見習一週。

ex.en: Can I shadow you at work tomorrow?
ex.zh: 我明天可以跟在你身邊見習嗎？

ex.en: The shareholders approved the merger.
ex.zh: 股東們通過了這項合併案。

ex.en: The annual shareholder meeting will be held in June.
ex.zh: 年度股東大會將在六月舉行。

ex.en: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.
ex.zh: 我在洗澡時電話響了。

ex.en: I didn't have time to take a shower today.
ex.zh: 我今天沒時間沖澡。

ex.en: She prefers baths rather than showers.
ex.zh: 比起沖澡，她更喜歡泡澡。

ex.en: I was showering a moment ago.
ex.zh: 我剛剛在洗澡。

ex.en: I usually shower in the morning.
ex.zh: 我通常早上沖澡。

ex.en: Expect a few showers this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午預計會有幾陣雨。

ex.en: We got caught in a shower on the way home.
ex.zh: 我們回家路上遇到一陣雨。

ex.en: He showered her with compliments.
ex.zh: 他對她讚不絕口。

ex.en: The fans showered the singer with flowers.
ex.zh: 歌迷向那位歌手獻上大量鮮花。

ex.en: Are you sure the book is on this shelf?
ex.zh: 你確定那本書在這個書架上嗎？

ex.en: You have too many books on the shelf.
ex.zh: 你書架上的書太多了。

ex.en: Can't you reach the book on the shelf?
ex.zh: 你拿不到架子上的那本書嗎？

shelf.zh: on the shelf / off the shelf：上架、現成可買的

ex.en: The new product will be on the shelves next month.
ex.zh: 新產品下個月就會上架。

ex.en: We bought the software off the shelf.
ex.zh: 我們買的是現成的套裝軟體。

ex.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
ex.zh: 我在海邊撿到一個漂亮的貝殼。

ex.en: The shell of an egg is easily broken.
ex.zh: 蛋殼很容易破。

ex.en: The snail retreated into its shell.
ex.zh: 蝸牛縮回殼裡去了。

ex.en: Can you help me shell the peanuts?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我剝花生嗎？

ex.en: She shelled the shrimp before cooking them.
ex.zh: 她煮蝦子前先把殼剝掉。

ex.en: We're going to set up shelters.
ex.zh: 我們要搭建避難所。

ex.en: We adopted our dog from an animal shelter.
ex.zh: 我們的狗是從動物收容所領養的。

ex.en: I had to take shelter under a tree.
ex.zh: 我只好在樹下躲雨。

ex.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
ex.zh: 孩子們的衣食住都要依靠父母。

ex.en: We took shelter from the storm in a café.
ex.zh: 我們躲進一家咖啡廳避暴風雨。

ex.en: These flowers should be sheltered from the rain.
ex.zh: 這些花應該要遮雨。

ex.en: The trees shelter the house from the wind.
ex.zh: 樹木替房子擋風。

ex.en: This is a world where the sun doesn't shine.
ex.zh: 這是一個沒有陽光的世界。

ex.en: The clouds opened and the sun shone through.
ex.zh: 雲散開了，陽光照了進來。

ex.en: If only that lamp weren't shining in my eye.
ex.zh: 要是那盞燈沒照到我眼睛就好了。

ex.en: Susan shined her father's shoes.
ex.zh: 蘇珊把她爸爸的鞋子擦亮了。

ex.en: He shines his shoes every morning.
ex.zh: 他每天早上擦亮鞋子。

ex.en: She really shines in math.
ex.zh: 她在數學方面表現特別出色。

ex.en: This is your chance to shine.
ex.zh: 這是你大顯身手的機會。

ex.en: Tom closed his eyes and began to count sheep.
ex.zh: 湯姆閉上眼睛開始數羊。

ex.en: Tom's uncle keeps a lot of sheep.
ex.zh: 湯姆的叔叔養了很多羊。

ex.en: Sheep are feeding in the meadow.
ex.zh: 羊群在草地上吃草。

ex.en: They sat in the shade of that big tree.
ex.zh: 他們坐在那棵大樹的樹蔭下。

ex.en: We had a rest in the shade.
ex.zh: 我們在樹蔭下休息。

ex.en: He likes green in a lighter shade.
ex.zh: 他喜歡淺一點的綠色。

ex.en: Do you have this shirt in a darker shade?
ex.zh: 這件襯衫有深一點的顏色嗎？

ex.en: Pull down the shade; the sun is too bright.
ex.zh: 把遮陽簾拉下來，太陽太刺眼了。

ex.en: The lamp needs a new shade.
ex.zh: 這盞燈需要換新燈罩。

ex.en: We went walking on the shore of the lake.
ex.zh: 我們沿著湖岸散步。

ex.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
ex.zh: 我在海邊撿到一個漂亮的貝殼。

ex.en: Now, get off the boat and swim to shore.
ex.zh: 現在下船，游到岸邊。

ex.en: The company cut costs to shore up its profits.
ex.zh: 公司削減成本以鞏固獲利。

ex.en: The government took steps to shore up the economy.
ex.zh: 政府採取措施支撐經濟。

ex.en: Is this river shallow?
ex.zh: 這條河很淺嗎？

ex.en: Children should swim in the shallow end of the pool.
ex.zh: 小孩應該在泳池淺水區游泳。

ex.en: Between you and me, he's a shallow thinker.
ex.zh: 私下跟你說，他的想法很膚淺。

ex.en: Tom is shallow.
ex.zh: 湯姆很膚淺。

ex.en: The secretary took notes in shorthand during the meeting.
ex.zh: 祕書在會議中用速記做筆記。

ex.en: Few people learn shorthand these days.
ex.zh: 現在很少人學速記了。

ex.en: "ASAP" is shorthand for "as soon as possible."
ex.zh: 「ASAP」是「as soon as possible」的縮寫。

ex.en: We use the word "sync" as shorthand for a quick meeting.
ex.zh: 我們用「sync」這個詞當作簡短會議的簡稱。

ex.en: I work for a shipping company.
ex.zh: 我在一家航運公司上班。

ex.en: Shipping is free for orders over 1,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 訂單滿一千元免運費。

ex.en: Your name is on the shortlist for the job.
ex.zh: 你已經進入這份工作的候選名單。

ex.en: We have a shortlist of three candidates.
ex.zh: 我們有三位入圍的候選人。

ex.en: She was shortlisted for the award.
ex.zh: 她入圍了這個獎項。

ex.en: Only five applicants will be shortlisted.
ex.zh: 只有五位應徵者會進入候選名單。

ex.en: There was a shortage of fuel.
ex.zh: 燃料短缺。

ex.en: Due to the water shortage, all the flowers in the garden have died.
ex.zh: 因為缺水，花園裡的花全都死了。

ex.en: The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.
ex.zh: 最近的咖啡短缺帶來了許多問題。

ex.en: This product has a shelf life of twelve months.
ex.zh: 這項產品的保存期限是十二個月。

ex.en: Check the shelf life before placing the order.
ex.zh: 下單前請確認保存期限。

ex.en: The shipper provided a tracking number by email.
ex.zh: 託運人透過電子郵件提供了追蹤號碼。

ex.en: Please contact the shipper about the damaged package.
ex.zh: 包裹受損的事請聯絡寄件人。

ex.en: How long does it take for the airport shuttle to get to the airport?
ex.zh: 機場接駁車到機場要多久？

ex.en: The hotel runs a free shuttle to the airport.
ex.zh: 飯店有免費的機場接駁車。

ex.en: This is the shortcut that I usually take to school.
ex.zh: 這是我平常上學走的捷徑。

ex.en: There is no shortcut to success.
ex.zh: 成功是沒有捷徑的。

ex.en: I created a shortcut on the desktop.
ex.zh: 我在桌面上建立了一個捷徑。

ex.en: Use this keyboard shortcut to save time.
ex.zh: 用這個快速鍵可以節省時間。

ex.en: There are many ships in the harbor.
ex.zh: 港口內有許多船。

ex.en: Modern ships only need a small crew.
ex.zh: 現代船隻只需要一小組的船員。

ex.en: A woman fell from a ship into the sea.
ex.zh: 有個女人從船上掉進了海里。

ex.en: We will ship your order tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天會寄出您的訂單。

ex.en: The products are shipped from Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這些產品從台灣出貨。

ex.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
ex.zh: 萬一貨運延誤，我們有特別的延誤保險。

ex.en: The shipment arrived two days late.
ex.zh: 這批貨晚了兩天到。

ex.en: Put old documents in the shredder.
ex.zh: 把舊文件放進碎紙機。

ex.en: The shredder is full again.
ex.zh: 碎紙機又滿了。

ex.en: Tom is working the night shift.
ex.zh: 湯姆上夜班。

ex.en: I start my morning shift at 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 我的早班早上 7 點開始。

ex.en: As tectonic plates shifted, uniquely adapted species of dinosaur emerged on each continent through vicariance.
ex.zh: 隨著板塊移動，各大洲因為地理隔離，演化出了適應不同環境的獨特恐龍。

ex.en: Public opinion has shifted in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來輿論已經轉變了。
